notes.title: [Important Announcement] Hades Relic Package Issue Update #1
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914780/8f86860edd7ee12847e3299789f5c1face140b72.png
Greetings Everyone, this is GM OceanSunfish

A while ago the Hades Relic Package was sent out into the shop and contained incorrect content as it was supposed to contain weapons but instead gears were delivered instead.

Please be noted that as told last time, users are given the opportunity to exchange the package content to it's correct items.

With that said, the initial sending of the items will be sent out this maintenance (Sept 16, 2025)

For those who have sent in inquiries or directly messaged me over at the official Discord, please do ensure that you have sent in your in-game names as to have the items corrected.

and of course, as per the previous post, you are also free to keep the Gears instead of exchanging them.

If you still wish to exchange the items or you have not received your package after this maintenance, please do contact me over at Discord or file a ticket with the title [Hades Relic Package] as we will be doing another batch one final time on the next scheduled bi-weekly maintenance.

Thank you for your continued playing of Combat Arms The Classic, and have a nice day.

notes.title: ​​​​​​​[Important Announcement] Hades Package Issue
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914780/969e44c428cdd77f85b629a0ff53d2453ec271a0.png
Hello Rangers,

The current Hades Package has incorrect text and display. It was meant as a Gear Package similar to Miracle League.

Firstly, we are unable to refund purchases as purchases are a one-time deal once the transaction goes through and completes.

Thus, while discussing with the team, we have concluded to offer the following in regards to this case:

Option A. Replace the gears for a weapon package.
1.) You can delete the gears in your inventory (delete, not sell)
2.) After deleting the items, you must file a ticket. You can contact GM OceanSunfish over at Discord as well after filing a ticket.

Items will be sent at set dates.

Option B. Keep the gears as is. We will not be deleting it, however, the weapon package will be made available at a later date.

VFUN Lounge Link Post: [Click Here]

Please be guided accordingly
- CA Team

notes.title: PATCH BRIEFING 04.12.2024
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914780/6f7c2a4cb572d81c360167e5ec2113e258f6cec3.pngPATCH BRIEFING

Hello, Rangers!

GM-vChaos here reporting in our patch briefing.

For this patch, we are trying out new ways of approach based on popular demand along with new weapons into our arsenal.

Let's take a look of the changes we are about to make.

BALANCE
Weapon Rebalance is one of the interesting topics that has been the word of mouth for a long time.
Our developers tread in this path very carefully and always looking for ways to give Rangers a fair fight against each other.

Based on the data, game experience and feedback, we have chosen one particular SMG
that has been bringing Rangers at the top of the battlefield. Stay tuned for more.

MAP UPDATES
I'm compiling an update for Terror Dome. I received a lot of feedback from competitive players, 
so I made some changes to make the map more balanced for both teams.

Terrordome Patch Notes:
- Fixed exploits that allowed players to leave the map
- Removed B-site alarms from Search & Destroy mode
- Various changes to improve map balance 
- Lowered ambient sound volume
- Improved lighting in Quarantine mode

We have also opened Game Modes for players to enjoy.
Arms Race
Capture the Flag
Last man standing
Quarantine Regen(HOT)
Spy Hunt
VIP Elimination

FIXES
Part of our patch briefing tackles some fixes that were reported by users.

> Fixed Wheel of Fate inventory that did not update last patch.
In my defense, GMChaos was hungry at the time and we're giving him more cheese.

> Fixed an issue where purchasing DarkHorizon's Package and Uruchi's Alternative Package causes an error to show.

We are hoping that these features are enjoyed by our players and as always,
if you have any ideas, GMvChaos is ready to jot them down for you.

For the community,
GM-vChaos

Spend GCOINS, get tons of rewards. Now that's a win-win situation!

It's time to rally your comrades and reignite the battlefield with the "Combat Arms Classic Commendation Event." Invite your friends back to the frontlines, and together, earn glorious rewards as you embark on an epic return to the heart-pounding action.

Prepare for the ultimate showdown in the "Highest Kill Count" challenge in Combat Arms Classic! Showcase your combat prowess and compete to achieve the most kills in an Elimination Match.

Event Duration:

 January 9th - January 14th (Announcement: January 15th)
 January 15th - January 21st (Announcement: January 22nd)


Announcement Date:

 January 15th (For the first event duration)
 January 22nd (For the second event duration)


How to Participate:
[olist]
 Join an Elimination Match in Combat Arms Classic during the event durations.
 Aim for the highest kill count you can achieve within each event period.
 Capture a screenshot of your in-game highest kill count. (full screenshot of the game)
 Post your screenshot along in this DISCORD with your in-game name (IGN).
[/olist]

Rewards:

1st Place:MYST-Hell Knight x5
2nd Place:MYST-Hell Knight x3
 3rd Place:MYST-Hell Knight  x1


Participate in both event durations for more chances to win exciting rewards and showcase your skills on the battlefield!

Get ready to dominate from January 9th to January 14th and January 15th to January 21st. Mark your calendars for the announcement dates on January 15th and January 22nd!

Attention all soldiers! The Prime Event will be live on (11/21/2023 CET) ~ (12/21/2023 CET) ,

Spend minimum required GCOINS to reach a tier and get tons of rewards.

Details:
1. Spend the minimum required GCOINS to reach a tier.
2. The player will only get the items on the tier reached plus the additional bonus rewards, other rewards that fall under the current tier will not be awarded.
3. The accumulated amount of GC will be rounded down to the nearest tier (eg. 2996 GC will be only eligible for the 2000 GC tier).
4. After the promotion period, the rewards will be inserted directly on the player's Inbox, on the nearest maintenance.

notes.title: Operation Blitz
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914780/18d9f858c59f399d939c3bb0b978924d424a7d8e.jpg
Attention Ranger!

Operation Boss Blitz will continue!! Gather your team, test your skill, attempt to set record on this stage and be rewarded!!

Event Rules:

1. Video Submission: After completing the scheduled stage in extreme difficulty tier, teams must record and upload their successful attempts to a video-sharing platform (YouTube, Twitch, etc.). The link to each video must be shared in the #event-submissions channel on the Discord server. "https://discord.gg/Q99Acdg5"

2. Integrity and Fair Play: Any form of cheating or exploiting glitches during the event is strictly prohibited. Violators will be disqualified from the event.

3. Reward Eligibility: Teams will be eligible for rewards based on their best clear time in Extreme difficulty tier. However, a team member can only receive rewards once., even if they manage to beat their own previous record.

4. Fastest Clear Reward: The team with the fastest clear time, will be crowned as the champions of the event Operation Blitz. In addition to the participation reward, they will be granted an exclusive grand prize.

5. Participation Reward: Every team that successfully participates in the event and submits their video for each difficulty tier will receive a special participation reward. The nature of the reward will be revealed at a later date.

Event Schedule and Stage Map

-Desert Thunder

-Event Start Date: 08/08/2023
-Event End Date: 15/08/2023

-Nemexis Labs

-Event Start Date: 15/08/2023
-Event End Date: 22/08/2023

-Freighter Frenzy

-Event Start Date: 22/08/2023
-Event End Date: 29/08/2023


1.Faster Clear Reward (Desert Thunder)

- Fatality Rose MK18 MOD1 (30 Days)
- Ultimate Weapon Renewal Kit x3
- Kiiken Shoujo 7 Days Package

Participation Reward

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914780/5033635a3de8752a9107d1fff00a7e1673879a0e.jpg
Attention Ranger!

A new and formidable challenge awaits you in the virtual battleground. Operation Boss Blitz is a special event where a team attempt a lightning-fast speed run to take down the fearsome new Double Boss.

Event Rules:

1. Video Submission: After completing the Double Boss encounter in each difficulty tier, teams must record and upload their successful attempts to a video-sharing platform (YouTube, Twitch, etc.). The link to each video must be shared in the #event-submissions channel on the Discord server.  (will update the discord ASAP for submission)

2. Integrity and Fair Play: Any form of cheating or exploiting glitches during the event is strictly prohibited. Violators will be disqualified from the event.

3. Reward Eligibility: Teams will be eligible for rewards based on their best clear time in normal difficulty tier. However, a team member can only receive rewards once., even if they manage to beat their own previous record.

4. Fastest Clear Reward: The team with the fastest clear time, will be crowned as the champions of the event Boss Blitz. In addition to the participation reward, they will be granted an exclusive grand prize, which will be announced at the conclusion of the event.

5. Participation Reward: Every team that successfully participates in the event and submits their video for each difficulty tier will receive a special participation reward. The nature of the reward will be revealed at a later date.

Event Schedule:
Event Start Date: 07/25/2023
Event End Date: 08/08/2023

notes.title: Video sharing event - September 2 to 16, 2022
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914780/ed2e8287c3b01932ccf28fea05bf98a2d4f20b63.jpg


CLICK HERE TO JOIN DISCORD!

Are you a hotshot in the game? We are giving you rangers a chance to showcase your awesome moment in the game. All you have to do is record your most awesome kills, gameplay. You can capture anything related in the game as running onto your enemies or winning the game with your clutch moment.

5 winners will win a Flower Package (3 Days) and Sport Package (3 Days), in addition, your video will be used and posted on our official YouTube.

Join our Discord channel

Show off!
Period: from 09/02 to 09/16

Rules
- Video needs to be raw (No edits,crash,texts)
- Video can be uploaded on YouTube or Google Drive (Should be downloadable). Once it is uploaded, you need to post the link on the Discord channel specifically on the #video-contest-submission-cac and use the tag #CACVIDEOENTRY with your character name.

Note:
All entries will be under review and verify by our Moderators and GM. If there will be any violation seen within the video, it will be investigated and punished once proven.

Participation of GM, Mods or Employees of Valofe Team is prohibited.

Winners will be posted via Discord and Facebook after the event had ended.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914780/0f44b382f451077e4242b2e4e10c447166a3804e.jpg

Hello Rangers!

How is your summer vacation? We do hope you are doing well and enjoying it. We know its really hot this summer. Our summer girls are already bringing you some watermelons to enjoy. Can you count how many watermelons in the picture?

Check the link to join: https://www.facebook.com/combatarmstheclassic.vfun/photos/a.566959530314139/1801161763560570/

Event Period: July 21 – July 31, 2022

Mechanics:
1. Like this post
2. Count how watermelons in the banner.
3. Comment on this Facebook post with the following details in the comment section of the event banner: #SummerOnCAC + *your answer* + IGN.
Sample entry: #SummerOnCAC + 17 + ElleChan.
4. There will be a total of 10 participants who answered correct will win the rewards.
Rewards:
- First 5 Summer Kamara (Common) / Second 5 Summer Mei (Common) total of 10
- MYST - Bastet Weapon Cache x1
- MYST - Bastet Gear Cache x1

Goodluck Rangers!

notes.title: Show Off!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914780/3a55dc38073ef20ba5dd7bf13fa99e574b80a5d9.jpg

Hello Rangers!


We know how much you love to play Combat Arms. We have prepared an event for you to show off your moments in the game that your friends, clan, and other players go sheesh with your awesome moments in the game. This can be your trick shots, QR moments, or killing spree.

Facebook event link: [HERE]


Wait there’s more, that best 5 videos or clips will be featured in our top plays in the future so watch out!

• Event Period: April 24 to 30, 2022

• Mechanics:

1. Like and share this post.

2. Upload a short video clip or a shareable link of your best moments.

3. After uploading or inputting the link, Include these on your entry.

#ShowOffCAC [Your In-game Name]

3. Sample Format: *Uploaded Image / Link* #ShowOffCAC - Trickster -

• Rewards: There will be 5 winners for this event and will receive Combat Dice x3, Boss Battle III x2, and Weapon Renewal Kit x2. Those who did not win, will still receive a participating reward of silver coins x3.

Note:

1. All event participants agree to abide by all rules stated above. Combat Arms: The Classic reserves the right to final interpretation of this event, its rules, and its rewards.

2. Double-check the in-game name entered to avoid missing the events.

3. Please upload your answer for the puzzle included with the information to be a winner.


Good luck rangers!

notes.title: What's your role?
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914780/e083ae28f2dde53edcfacb437460fae36142eed1.jpg

Hello Rangers,

We all know that you enjoy fighting zombies and infected. So we would like to know what role you like to use during a zombie apocalypse.

Are you an agile that wields melee to SMG weapons, a marksman who loves to sniper weapons with long-range weapons, or you are a gun-slinging guy who wants to be loud and wipe them all out using a machine gun or assault rifle? Here are some weapons to help you figure out your role when the time comes.

Facebook event link: https://www.facebook.com/combatarmst...00472260296188

Like = AK-74M Gold-Plated
Heart = Warcorp DSR-1 Tactical
Wow = Hauser's M60E4
Care = Balisong Knife

Event duration: March 4 to 11, 222

Mechanics:
1. Like and share this post.
2. You can join by reacting to this post with the corresponding emoji then commenting in this post with the following entry details:
#CAC + [Weapon] + [Reason] + Your character name in CAC
3. Sample Entry:

#CAC + Balisong Knife + I like to go quiet and kill zombies in a stealthy way + Dekard_Maru

• Rewards: Winners will receive the corresponding weapon chosen. (example: If you choose Warcorp DSR-1 Tactical, you will win the Warcorp DSR-1 Tactical). Only 5 winners per role will be won. All weapons will be 7 Days duration.

Note: All event participants agree to abide by all rules stated above. Combat Arms: The Classic reserves the right to final interpretation of this event, its rules, and its rewards. Please don't change the name until the winner's list is posted.

Double-check the in-game name entered to avoid missing the events.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914780/59ff3e6f54a63c2beb99807e2a9a3f31d46b0441.jpg
Rangers,

It's still love month and headquarters are sending love all over the world. We would like to know how much love playing Combat Arms. Give us a selfie showing you are playing Combat Arms. 20 winners that have a creative selfie will win Valentine's Day AUG A3 (15 Days).

Facebook community event link: I HEART CAC

• Event Period: February 18 to 28, 2022.

• Mechanics:

1. Like and share this post

2. Comment in this post your selfie entry with the following
#iheartCombatArms [Your Character name]

3.Sample entry: #iheartCombatArms - DaddyMogs

Additional Information:

1. Please don’t change your character name when joining the events.

2. Be creative as you can include your loved one on the selfie or a selfie of your friends in-game or real life.

• Rewards: There will be 20 winners for this event and will receive Valentine's Day AUG A3 (15 Days)

Note: All event participants agree to abide by all rules stated above. Combat Arms: The Classic reserves the right to final interpretation of this event, its rules, and its rewards.

Double-check the in-game name entered to avoid missing the events.

Love and peace Rangers!

Hello Rangers,

We had dropped a care package at our outpost. Can you spot the package with the same item inside?

Facebook event link: [HERE]

- Event Period: January 20 to 31, 2022
- Mechanics:
1. Like and share this post
2. Spot the two packages with the same content
3. Comment in this post your answer. Following this format
#CACcarepackage [In-game name] + [Answer]
4.Sample entry: #CACcarepackage + Ceasar + Package X and Y

- Rewards: 15 Participants who answered correctly will receive L85A1 MOD CAMO (15 Days)

Note: All event participants agree to abide by all rules stated above. Combat Arms: The Classic reserves the right to final interpretation of this event, its rules, and its rewards.

Double check the in-game name you entered to avoid missing the event and reward.

Good luck Rangers.

notes.title: Memories for Combat Arms in 2021 - January 5 to 14, 2022
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914780/1bc0496a2f947af1b4485e81839505f47d1834ae.jpg
Happy New Rangers!

First of all, we would like to thank you all for another year of Combat Arms: The Classic. We truly appreciate playing and enjoying the game. Looking back with 2021, we enjoy having you around. Why not share with us your memories, experience, and story with Combat Arms: The Classic for 2021.

We will give 15 participants a reward of Advance Era M4A1 (15 Days) for sharing with us your exciting story for Combat Arms.

Event Link: https://www.facebook.com/combatarmst...0674750942606/

• Event Period: January 5 to 14, 2022.
• Mechanics:
1. Like and share this post
2. Comment in this post your answer. Following this format
#LookbackCAC [Your In-game Name] - Your exciting memory from Combat Arms Year 2021
3. Sample entry:#LookbackCAC Kaboom23- Practicing parkour with my friends on quarantine mode was fun

• Rewards: There will be 15 winners for this event and will receive Advance Era M4A1 (15 Days).
Note: All event participants agree to abide by all rules stated above. Combat Arms: The Classic reserves the right to final interpretation of this event, its rules, and its rewards.
Double-check your in-game name entered to avoid missing the event.

Rangers,

Why are you still online? You should spend time with friends & family. Well since you're here, we've prepared a little present for you. Count the number of gift boxes on the Christmas tree. 20 winners that answered correctly will receive a holiday reward.

Facebook Event Page: [Here]

• Event Period: December 21 to 28, 2021.
• Mechanics:
1. Like and share this post
2. Comment in this post your answer. Following this format
#ChristmasCAC [Your In-game Name] - Answer
3.Sample entry: #ChristmasCAC Santa - 23 Gift boxes

• Rewards: There will be 20 winners for this event and will receive Christmas FAMAS G2 (30 Days)

Note: All event participants agree to abide by all rules stated above. Combat Arms: The Classic reserves the right to final interpretation of this event, its rules, and its rewards. Double-check the in-game name entered to avoid missing the events.

Happy holidays Rangers.

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914780/7df0c51e7b21960b37ed76e3ae47197733c8afa3.jpg

Rangers,

Headquarters is in a move to clear out an infested site. We had given rangers a variety of weapons to use for this mission. What do you think is the best weapon for this mission to succeed?

Facebook community event link: [Here]

1. Like emoji: Aug A3 SE (Rare) (7 Days).
2. Heart emoji: ACR Blacksnake(Rare) (7 Days).
3. Care emoji: Warcorp DSR-1 Tactical (Rare) (7 Days).
4. Wow emoji: PP-19 MOD CAMO (Rare) (7 Days).

• Event Period: November 9 to 16, 2021.
• Mechanics:
1. React with the corresponding emoji and share this post.
2. Comment in this post the following details of your official entry:
#WeaponCAC [In-game name] - Name of Weapon among the choices
3. Sample entry: #WeaponCAC Ash - ACR Blacksnake

• Rewards: There will be five winners from (like, heart, care, wow) reactions. A total of 20 winners to be given.

Note: All event participants agree to abide by all rules stated above. Combat Arms: The Classic reserves the right to final interpretation of this event, its rules, and its rewards.

Double-check the in-game name entered to avoid missing the events.


Best of luck Rangers.

notes.title: Halloween Community Event
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914780/bf45aa5cd06f771494e690563db0a3eb20dc7c47.jpg\
Hello Rangers,

Halloween is just around the corner! Headquarters are setting up some Jack O’ Lanterns!. In fact, we made a lot of it we lost count of them all. We need your help rangers to count them. If you can guess the right number of Jack O’ Lanterns, we’ll set you up with a Halloween Shovel (7 Days) as a reward! How many do you think are there?

Community Event Link: https://www.facebook.com/combatarmst...02626520080763

• Event Period: October 15 to 31, 2021.
• Mechanics:
1. Like and share this post.

2. Comment in this post the following details of your official entry:
#HalloweenCAC IGN - the answer to the amount of Jack O’ Lanterns. Plus tag two of your friends.

3. Sample entry: #HalloweenCAC IGN: Chuckie - 23 Jack O’ Lanterns Deckard Mika.

• Rewards: There will be 15 winners that will receive the Halloween Shovel (7 Days) who are able to give the correct answer and early.

Note: All event participants agree to abide by all rules stated above. Combat Arms: The Classic reserves the right to final interpretation of this event, its rules, and its rewards.

Best of luck Rangers.

The Headquarters is getting ready for an assault into an infected area. Armory has given 4 weapons to use for this assault. What is your preferred weapon for this assault?

⦁ Mechanics:
1. Share and react with the corresponding emoji of your choice on the post.
2. There will be five winners each from (like, heart, care, wow) reactions. A total of 20 winners. To be eligible, please follow the mechanics.
3. Post the following details in the comment section of the event banner:
My favorite #CACOctoberWeapons is ____________, your IGN.

My favorite #CACOctoberWeapons is Halloween Shovel, IGN: Deckard.

Attention Rangers!

In pursue of information for the international terrorist group Babaroga, Wraith had infiltrated one of the bases of this group. He was able to reach the head office with the confidential files in the computer, but the location of bases needs to be deciphered to locate them. Can you help Wraith solving this puzzle?

Event Link: https://www.facebook.com/combatarmstheclassic.vfun/photos/a.566959530314139/1580634032280012

   Event Period: September 14 -28, 2021
   Mechanics:
[olist]
 During the event duration, players can join and identify all the countries that can be seen in the puzzle. Answers may be spelled backward.
 Comment in this post the following details for your official entry: IGN plus the countries you have found in the crossword.
 Sample entry:[/olist]IGN: Wraith.
- Alaska
- Nepal

 There will be 15 winners that will receive the L85A1 MOD CAMO (7 days) who were able to find all the locations.

Note:

All event participants agree to abide by all rules stated above. Combat Arms: The Classic reserves the right to final interpretation of this event, its rules, and its rewards.

Best of luck Rangers.

Attention Rangers!

Check the event page [HERE]

 Mechanics:

1. Pick your preferred weapon just by choosing the corresponding reaction of your choice.

My load out for this #Rescuemission is ____________, your IGN.

Note:
1. Please use and double check the In-game name you had used for entry.

notes.title: Desert Deathmatch & Outpost 31 (Quarantine Regen)
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914780/2481b9f9f6fdacfdf8316a0c9a5580a4fb148891.jpg
Desert Deathmatch
We have added a new Boss battle for you to conquer. This will be a team battle with two phases, you heard it right two bosses will be encountered on this new map.

We introduce to you the Beetle and the Scorpion. Both monsters have unique skills that will test your survival skills. 

1st boss - The Beetle

This boss is protected by a thick layer of armor, discovering the weak spot is a must! It has a set of skills that will use a defensive stance, dash, and cocoon skills separately.

 Dash: The beetle rushes through a straight line quickly, dealing damage to enemies in its path.
 Cocoon: The beetle spits out a cloud of slime (which cannot be avoided) to trap a player in. If the cocoon is not destroyed after a while, it will hatch many mobs.
 Defensive stance: The beetle raises its forelimbs for defense, which will also summon many mobs, and the beetle's weaknesses will be exposed.

Also, be aware that if you are on the striking range the Beetle will attack by swinging its forelimbs at you!

2nd boss - The Scorpion

After you have defeated the defensive Beetle, the deadly Scorpion will be coming above ground. He has deathly skills that could wipe your team from battle. You need to be aware of his skills Ground Crash, Venom Barrage, and Ground Sting skills.


 Ground Crash: The scorpion raises its forelimb and smashes them on the ground, dealing damage to enemies directly in front of it.
 Venom Barrage: The scorpion uses its tail to quickly spray a circle of bullets. Players need to dodge or they need to bear damage if got hit.
  Ground Sting: The scorpion buries its tail stinger in the ground and spines it out quickly after a certain time, causing damage to nearby players.

Be aware that these bosses are not alone as they are accompanied by small beetles and mosquitoes that will come and attack you also. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914780/2885b16ca0ff19c3474554bfd4420b344a51c007.jpg
Quarantine Regen - Outpost 31

We have discovered a new outbreak! The newest map added to the Quarantine Regen is Outpost 31. 

Players will try to survive by killing or avoiding being infected within the time limit. Be careful as going outside the research facility will give out frostbite damage. 

Plan it out with your comrades as you try to kill or survive the infected going at you.

• Event Period: July 20, - July 27, 2021

• Mechanics:
 [olist]
 Pick your preferred weapons just by clicking the corresponding reaction of your choice.
 There will be five winners from (like, heart, care, wow) reactions. A total of 20 winners. To be eligible, please follow the mechanics.
 Post the following details in the comment section of the event banner: My favorite #CACJulyWeapons is ____________, your IGN.
 Sample entry: ”My favorite #CACJulyWeapons is L85A1 MOD CAMO, IGN: CaCRocks." [/olist]
• Rewards:
The rewards would be the player’s weapon of choice (14 days).

1.Like emoji: AUG A3 SE (Rare).

notes.title: June and Win
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914780/2206cf8813ad3f82fab0b1fba99e463b21676e4a.jpg

Attention Rangers!

The Headquarters offers you a very convenient way to earn your favorite weapons just by casting your vote through Facebook reactions. Please visit our Facebook page to join the event.
	
	● Event Period: June 15, - June 29, 2021
	● Mechanics:
       1. Pick your preferred weapons just by clicking the corresponding reaction of your choice.
       2. There will be five winners from (like, heart, care, wow) reactions. A total of 20 winners. To be eligible, please follow the mechanics.
       3. Post the following details in the comment section of the event banner:
			My favorite #CACJuneWeapons is ____________ , your IGN. 
       4. Sample entry ”My favorite #CACJuneWeapons is L85A1 MOD CAMO, IGN: CaCRocks" 

	● Rewards: The rewards would be the player’s weapon of choice (14 days).
       
	   1.Like emoji : ACR Blacksnake (Rare).
       2.Heart emoji: AK-74M Gold-Plated (Rare).
       3.Care emoji: AUG A3 SE (Rare)
       4.Wow emoji: L85A1 MOD CAMO (Rare).

See you on the battlefield Rangers!

Attention Rangers!

The Headquarters offers you a very convenient way to earn your favorite AK weapons just by casting your vote through Facebook reactions.

• Event Period: May 11, - May 25, 2021

• Mechanics:
1. Pick your preferred AK weapons just by clicking the corresponding reaction of your choice.
2. There will be five winners from (like, heart, care, wow) reactions. A total of 20 winners. To be eligible, please follow the mechanics.
3. Post the following details in the comment section of the event banner:
My favorite #CACAK47Weapon is ____________, your IGN.
4. Sample entry”
My favorite #CACAK47Weapon is AK-47 Anubis IGN: CaCRocks.

• Rewards:

The rewards would be the player’s weapon of choice (14 days).
1. Like emoji: AK-103 Gold-Plated (Rare).
2. Heart emoji: AK-74M Gold-Plated (Rare).
3. Care emoji: AK-47 Anubis (Rare)
4. Wow emoji: Leviathan AK-47 SOPMOD (Rare).

See you on the battlefield Rangers!

notes.title: FM versus FM Event
notes.content:
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37914780/191fe1a6a184dce607052cefdaa8d186a24a9a41.png

Rangers!

FM versus FM will be the next big player event!

We would like to invite you to our FM vs FM Event this Saturday (08.05.2021)! Do not miss the chance to win some awesome rewards if you are on the winner team!

[Mechanics]

- To get the event rewards, you need to be on the winning team.
- If by the End of the match, you are the top scorer of the wining team, rewards will be doubled for you!
- The players must participate in the whole match to get all rewards.
- Only one match will be given to players to get a chance of winning!
- There will be an announcement on Discord shortly before the event starts by one of the Moderators.
- The Event will start at 16:00 CEST / 07:00 PDT.
- The event Rooms will be announced randomly in-game or via the Discord server.

[Event Mode]

• Game Mode: FM's choice (most likely: SnD, E-Pro & CtF)
• Map: FM's choice
• Restriction: FM’s choice
[Rewards]
• MYST - Blacklist Conviction x1
• MYST - Arcade x1
[
Rules]

- Only players that will remain in-game until the last round will win the rewards.
- Follow the FM’s instruction on this event.
- Players can only participate once.

- Players who will receive two warnings will not get the rewards.
- Read and abide all the mechanics and rules.
- Anyone caught using an illegal software will be out of the event and will also be banned.

[Disclaimer]

- By joining this event and becoming a participant signifies that you automatically agree to all our terms and conditions.
- The decision of the FM’s is final and undisputable, and we have the right to change any part of the mechanics including the prizes as we deem fit without prior notice.

Hoooooo ~ Aaahhhh!

NEW FUNCTION

Room Rank Restriction

1. When the players create a room, they can give the room a certain rank limit (which did not exist until the update). There are currently two new restrictions:
1-30 (Rookie Zone)
31-60 (Veteran Zone)

2. There are some conditions to create restricted-rank rooms
The players whose rank under 30 can only create Rookie Zone and non-restricted Zone.
The players whose rank from 31-49 can only create non-restricted Zone.
The players whose rank over 50 can only create Veteran Zone and non-restricted Zone.

3. When a player creates a room, he or she can choose the corresponding rank limit or not. Once created, players can also change the settings for rank limits. However, players can only switch from Rookie/Veterans to unrestricted, not from unrestricted to Rookie/Veterans. Similarly, Rookie and Veteran cannot have switched each other.

4. Rooms that have created restrictions have an explicit icon in the list of rooms in the lobby, and no-icon indicate no-restrictions.

5. No password can be set for Rookie/Veteran restricted rooms.

BUG FIX

1. Fixed the graphical problem of several guns that shows black polygonal shape.

notes.title: ROLLBACK FAQ’s
notes.content:
ROLLBACK FAQ’s:

1. What will happen to the GC I used to make purchases from March 9 (10:30 CET) – 11?
The GC and GP you used during those dates will be refunded on your respective accounts.

2. How can I secure my account?
We highly suggest that you change your password immediately, to ensure safety of your account.

3. What will happen to my items/weapons obtained when I opened boxes?
The weapons/items you obtained during the incident dates will be wiped out on your account, and the GC you used will be refunded back to your account.

4. Are you going to revert the items/weapons I exchanged?
Yes, you will have your items/weapons you sold back, but the GP you obtained after selling them will stay on your account (Free GP).

We apologize for this inconvenience. To compensate, we will also give rewards that you are supposed to obtain from our system events. In addition, you are also entitled to other rewards, please see your inbox.

notes.title: Steam Overlay Temporary Fix
notes.content:
Attention Rangers!

HQ is aware on the issues with the Steam Overlay. Steam users will encounter some difficulty accessing the load-up page as it utilizes the Steam Overlay system. 

Our teams are now working on a fix to be delivered ASAP. In the meantime, we found a workaround to prevent issues with the Steam overlay. We recommend our Steam client users to run "Steam" as administrator. 

Below are a few steps on how to run Steam as administrator.

How to Run Steam as Administrator from the Start Menu
1. Open Start.
2. Right-click the Steam icon
3. Select the More submenu, and click the Run as administrator option.

How to run Steam as administrator using Search
1. Open Start.
2. Type in "Steam" in the search box.
3. Navigate towards the searched app and Click the Run as administrator option from the right side. (Sometimes, the option is hidden until you click the down-arrow button.)

How to run Steam as administrator using desktop
1. Locate the Steam icon on your Desktop
2. Right click on the Steam icon to access the context menu.
3. Select the Run as Administrator from the menu.

We apologize for any inconveniences caused by this issue. Keep yourselves posted for then latest development on the resolution on this matter our website and our official channels.

Thank you for your continued support for Combat Arms: the Classic

Regards,
Combat Arms Team

notes.title: Operation: Metal War
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914780/8b6239d0a2338a5a43e79d710dc63880b068f013.jpg

Boss Battle II – Freighter Frenzy Introduction

General Quarters! This is not a drill!

Attention! Our escort sortie is now in effect. A large, hostile force has boarded the ship and severely crippled our sea-going ability.  Reports indicate that the invading forces are autonomous weapons systems aimed to destroy everything on board. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914780/8a6c4fd0ab366f89acd3f0a04b57400596b9fc56.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914780/df93163adbba1a9e31fa0215c76547b8dbcd9e66.png

Move out! Hooo~ah!!!

Take part in a chaotic brawl of man versus machine and challenge your skills for both combat and team coordination in this action-packed game mode.

On this update, we made sure that both our veterans and newcomers alike will have heart-pumping, adrenaline-rush inducing experience that will keep you on your toes, all the time.

We haven’t even talked about the rewards. We didn’t forget that. As always, every challenge comes with some handsome rewards. We are pretty sure that you’ll be blasting these challenges to earn more.

notes.title: COMBAT ARMS the: CLASSIC
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914780/6a88e67ff7d188b36ca23494ce8435481fba5c48.jpg

OVERVIEW

-	Abilities are categorized into two types: Active and Passive.

	Active Abilities have a usage time limit and a cooldown period. They are only active after triggering. They are activated by pressing ~ and the slot they are assigned to.

	Passive Abilities are always active during gameplay.

-	Players have three ability slots, which can be filled by up to three abilities. Some abilities take more than one slot, however. Equipping them limits the number of abilities a player may bring to battle.


ACTIVE ABILITIES
EAGLE EYE

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914780/287cf71bed2c68c84bdcf813f0cccf75e2a17e67.png

-	Information: Improves accuracy for both you and your teammates. This ability will not apply to any weapons not dependent on accuracy (such as Mines or Claymores).
-	Type: Active
-	Ability Slot: 2


RESOURCEFUL

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914780/509d18701d86be9f9ea68cc0c9f916f083d39315.png

-	Information: When you kill an enemy player, there’s a chance they may leave behind Limited-Ammo, All-Ammo, or Recovery Items! You will have a short time to pick these up, after which they will be free for your team to recover.
-	Type: Active
-	Ability Slot: 1


SPOILS OF WAR

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914780/f35119965f55242f9c0b44bb8f8bea5fe7dfcab8.png

-	Information: Earn 10 GP for any firearms recovered from fallen soldiers during battle. This ability works up to 10 times per match.
-	Type: Active
-	Ability Slot: 2

notes.title: COMBAT ARMS the: CLASSIC
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914780/63799b3cd034a0eb8e8dbdd269d835df8f514f79.jpg

WAVE RIDER

Introduction: Having failed to recover the Two Towers region that was isolated from the 5th Corps' line of defense and the enemy counterattack, there was no choice for allied forces but to fall back to the last remaining stronghold in the area, the city of Rupheria. Here, our forces have laid plans to ambush the incoming enemy from the rooftops of all the city's buildings, from St. Paul's church to the lighthouse.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914780/4773dec28b6ec3c52d959fb172049913158b43b4.jpg

Description: The city's design resembles that of Two Towers. Since it is a "continuation" of the Two Towers plot (as well as being within the same vicinity), this would naturally make sense. Also known as the legendary "Rooftop Map," Waverider features a variety of game modes. It is a massive map that is more difficult to memorize than others in the game. There are plenty of stairways, and a couple of tunnels and doors scattered around the map.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914780/48d008179d6a588ad40a78c9eaa55bac03b50da2.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914780/e44cd00aa5db5810afd66fdbafe29e9d1c54db25.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914780/c264b7a385389bdc323d2569fa7bd021eaafedd7.jpg

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914780/63799b3cd034a0eb8e8dbdd269d835df8f514f79.jpg

SILENT SQUARE

Introduction: An expelled secret agent from JSF organization requested refuge. Creed decided to provide him a refuge because he has all the secret information of JSF who is active all over the world. Creed agent came to contact with him at a small town square. However, JSF agents attacked Creed agent and the square became chaos.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914780/4f0d6fc4df77bfc5374fc2ffd34086161718322e.jpg


Description: The new map is called Silent Square and takes players to a European town that provides an intense (and claustrophobic) new combat experience.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914780/65a067b11773e16bff16bd6b9a303388968bb14c.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914780/72bf9a87c5114049251d0c915a09eb7d76dc133f.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914780/4bb88b10fe6e0a5911486d385aee62bf84719cfc.jpg

notes.title: COMBAT ARMS the: CLASSIC
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914780/63799b3cd034a0eb8e8dbdd269d835df8f514f79.jpg

COSTA RECON

Introduction: The insurgent forces are tipped off that their supply outpost, OP Slaven 152, is in danger, and decide their supplies must be relocated. Unfortunately, the military detects its relocation efforts. Now the insurgents must secure their supplies by either blowing them up or moving them before the imminent military raid.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914780/071c8c779fa68ec216bbfe4311fe34047c278bd0.jpg

Description: The map takes place along a beach outpost. It is having an asymmetrical design. It is about twice the size of Junk Flea and features two large shed-like buildings at either end of the map, two small houses in the middle, and a large amount of boxes/crates in the middle. 



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914780/003c998c93ab9a31e52f8584b96b96fcde8292eb.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914780/25815377ec6088f9f4a68eb728b213cda23eba34.jpg

notes.title: COMBAT ARMS the: CLASSIC
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914780/63799b3cd034a0eb8e8dbdd269d835df8f514f79.jpg


SNOW VALLEY

Introduction: A hostile missile base has been spotted by our Lockeland U-5 reconnaissance aircraft in a disputed region between borders. The enemy has been preparing the launch of a nuclear warhead at a neighboring nation. Eliminate any enemy forces found within the complex and recover the missile.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914780/77ce801551fdabf6220980a77caef33fe1397f16.jpg

Description: Snow Valley is the 2nd of Combat Arms' five original maps. It was also the first snow-based map ever released. Snow Valley features a vast, frozen landscape, with several hills, fences, and walls, along with a silo and main tower. A large, subterranean tunnel links the entire map below-ground, providing a shortcut to various parts of the map.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914780/2c68c7f4042882708bbfd150071fb8e74ce5e660.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914780/5f02c408da8168943a3cf3ae0c1dddbca723e4bf.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914780/8ee26d48e3d4675b546cc5c7e2938f12cc6db58c.jpg

notes.title: COMBAT ARMS the: CLASSIC
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914780/63799b3cd034a0eb8e8dbdd269d835df8f514f79.jpg


OIL RIG

Introduction: Intelligence acquired by a UAF agent has discovered that a large cache of stolen funds and resources have been hidden by War Corp on a decommissioned Oil Rig. UAF agents are being dispatched to secure the platform and clear out any remaining War Corp personnel.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914780/b525fa12c99c93d64e5b4726b1b2949a36d32441.jpg

Description: Originally drafted by in-game player FractalShot on the 2010's Map Design Contest, Oil Rig is the 31st map to be released in Combat Arms, and one of the first maps to be remastered. Oil Rig is a large map consisting of, as its name suggests, an oil rig in the middle of an ocean. In team game modes, spawns are located at each end of the map: the 'pump' station and living quarters. Stairs and ladders are present in and around each respective spawns allowing players to access the rooftops and crane.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914780/142245904e7693bc02e4c8570187cf0f088e7d87.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914780/351e3b2fb9baee611716ebccda41a9a6321fbbd4.jpg
